about: Real recordings to test the analysis and the drawing against. All freely licensed and fetched from the Internet Archive by tools/fetch_test_songs.sh into testsongs/ (git-ignored: audio never goes in the repo). 'tests' says what each one exercises.

songs.title: Dropping Out of School
songs.tests: indie rock: distorted and clean guitars, bass, drums, voice; lyrics on LRCLIB

songs.title: Fluoride
songs.tests: rock with heavy distorted guitars and cymbals; lyrics on LRCLIB (one record of the same length among others)

songs.title: Code Monkey
songs.tests: pop rock with a clear lead voice; its tags name the wrong artist ('spiffworld'), and covers of the same length exist, so no lyrics are found

songs.title: Incoherent
songs.tests: acoustic guitar and voice; lyrics on LRCLIB

songs.title: Hey Ruth
songs.tests: folk rock; lyrics on LRCLIB at 204 s, 3.6 s longer than this copy, so refused as another version

songs.title: Goldberg Variations: Aria

songs.title: Guitar Solo 1989
